\frac{\text{BC}}{h} = \cos \theta \\
\text{BC} = h \cos \theta \checkmark \\

\frac{\text{BD}}{\text{BC}} = \tan \alpha \\
\text{BD} = \text{BC} \tan \alpha = h \cos \theta \cdot \frac{\sin \alpha}{\cos \alpha} \checkmark \\
\text{AB} = h \sin \theta \\

= \frac{h \sin \theta \cos \alpha - h \cos \theta \sin \alpha}{\cos \alpha} \\
= \frac{h(\sin \theta \cos \alpha - \cos \theta \sin \alpha)}{\cos \alpha} \\
= \frac{h \sin(\theta - \alpha)}{\cos \alpha} \checkmark
